title: LEGO Has Produced 10 Billion Minifigures Since 1978
hook: That cumulative output now exceeds today's 8.1 billion people.
closing: The comparison measures decades of toy production, not figures that still exist.
question: How many are in your house?

segments.say: LEGO has produced 10 billion minifigures, versus a world population of 8.1 billion. This compares production, not surviving toys.
By 2019, LEGO had produced 8.3 billion minifigures. Four decades of output built the cumulative total.
LEGO makes 400 million minifigures yearly, nearly three times the 134 million babies born. Production keeps widening the cumulative gap.
